notes.subject: sigini-yɔrɔ
notes.rationale: שבת is literally 'sitting/session' — a throne or seat of rule, not merely furniture; rendered 'seat'.

notes.subject: putting far / bringing near
notes.rationale: Chiasm of distance: they push the evil day far off while dragging the seat of violence close; kept in the Bambara word order.

translation: Minnu bɛ don min bɛ gɛlɛya ka nɛnɛ ka a to yɔrɔ jan na, ka misiginni sigini-yɔrɔ ɲɛ da a ma.

tokens.gloss: minnu bɛ … ka nɛnɛ ka a to yɔrɔ jan na
